title: fix(console): opening the console at its root asks /meta/app and the boot preference read once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D1zB2RQoKXdgdm6Pi9dAVJX)_

Fixes #32633

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:控制台根地址 `/` 的落点跳转,改为挂在与 `/home`、`/apps/…`、`/forms/…` 同一个布局路由下,共用同一套数据外壳;组织检查和权限范围下移一层,只罩跳转目的地。
- 为什么改:从 `/_console/` 打开时,根路由自带一套数据外壳,跳到默认应用后目的路由又挂一套新的,`/meta/app` 和启动偏好读(`sys_user_preference`)各多发一次,首屏前多一轮串行往返。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx` 的路由结构;落点规则和组织检查结果不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx`(布局路由那一段)、`App.rootLandingReadsOnce-32633.test.tsx`、5 个旧测试里补的 `RequireOrganization` 桩。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/App.rootLandingReadsOnce-32633.test.tsx`,预期 2 个用例全绿(根地址与直接打开应用页都各请求一次)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx` only (plus tests and a changeset):

- The `/` route (the landing redirect, `RootLandingRedirect`) moves from a top-level route with its own `ProtectedRoute` into the pathless layout route that already holds `/home`, `/apps/:appName/*` and `/forms/:name`.
- That layout's element is now `ConsolePermissionsRequest` beside `ProtectedRoute requireOrganization={false}`. A nested pathless layout under it carries `RequireOrganization` and `ConsolePermissionsScope` over the three destinations only, so the composition the destinations render under is unchanged (AuthGuard, ConnectedShell, the organization gate, the permissions scope), and `/` keeps its old posture: no organization gate, no permissions scope, it only redirects.
- The redirect from `/` to the landing app (or `/home`) now keeps the one `ConnectedShell`: its adapter, its `MetadataProvider` with the `/meta/app` answer the landing was resolved from, and the `UserStateBridge` whose attach issues the boot `sys_user_preference` read. Before, the redirect unmounted that shell and the destination mounted a second one, which asked both again one wave later.

No file `domain:ui#2` #32627 holds is touched (`context/*Preferences*`, the pollers, the palette, `data-objectstack/src/userState.ts`).

## Why

Mechanism measured (the card left it open between "the redirect remounts the shell providers" and "a second caller after the redirect"): it is the remount. Probe on the pre-fix route tree, URLs in request order, opening `/`:

- `/api/v1/discovery`, `/api/v1/meta/app`, `/api/v1/data/sys_user_preference?…`, `/api/v1/auth/me/permissions`, `/api/v1/meta/app`, `/api/v1/meta/app/crm/bundle`, `/api/v1/data/sys_user_preference?…` (same URL), `/api/v1/me/apps`, `/api/v1/data/sys_user/u1`

After the fix, opening `/`: `/api/v1/auth/me/permissions`, `/api/v1/discovery`, `/api/v1/meta/app`, `/api/v1/data/sys_user_preference?…`, `/api/v1/meta/app/crm/bundle`, `/api/v1/me/apps`, `/api/v1/data/sys_user/u1`: no URL twice, and `/auth/me/permissions` now leaves in the first wave (its early request is mounted from `/` too, and the scope takes it after the redirect). Discovery and the user's locale row were not repeated before either (the first commit message says they were; the follow-up commit corrects that).

Not done, per the order: no cross-session cache, no suppression of a legitimate refetch (a language switch still remounts `MetadataProvider` under its `key`).

## Tests

- New `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/App.rootLandingReadsOnce-32633.test.tsx`: the real `App` route tree, `ProtectedRoute`, `ConsoleShell` with its user-state providers, `ConnectedShell` with the real `ObjectStackAdapter`, `MetadataProvider` and `UserStateBridge`, `RootLandingRedirect`, `RequireOrganization`, `ConsolePermissionsScope`; the network is the console's authenticated fetcher, recording every URL.
  - Opening `/` lands on `/apps/crm` with `/meta/app` asked once, the boot `sys_user_preference` read asked once, and no URL asked twice.
  - CONTROL: opening `/apps/crm` directly, the same three assertions.
- Five route-tree tests that reduce `ProtectedRoute` to a passthrough (`App.homePermissions-12700`, `App.nativeShellMode-29039`, `App.uploadAltitude-10131`, `internalFormShell`, `FormPage.routePermissions-29187`) now stub `RequireOrganization` the same way: the gate used to sit inside the stubbed `ProtectedRoute` and now sits beside it. `App.permissionsWave-29114` keeps the real `ProtectedRoute` and real `RequireOrganization` and passes unchanged.

Restore: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (330d1865e82e) and git diff HEAD is empty`. The console app's source is imported directly by the test (no dist on the path), so no rebuild leg.
- Fixed: the new test `2 passed (2)`.

After merging `main` (3 commits, no overlap with this diff, same 35 derived) re-run on ae1583e4: `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`: all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The browser reading on the card (staging, 21 vs 18 requests) is not re-taken here; the request-count test is the instrument. The card's cloud-side budget check for the root entry stays the cloud card the triage note names.
- The order reads "the boot preference read requested once"; the test counts every `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user_preference` regardless of query, so a second differently-filtered read would also fail it.

## Verification

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/App.rootLandingReadsOnce-32633.test.tsx` (2 passed). CI: the PR's check-runs.
